PRODUCT OVERVIEW

H300 is a full-size four-stroke gasoline off-road motorcycle with 21 kW maximum power, a six-speed international gearbox, LED lighting and an 11 L fuel tank.

FOUR-STROKE ENGINE21 kW maximum power and 27 N·m torque.
FULL-SIZE CHASSIS1485 mm wheelbase and 300 mm ground clearance.
OFF-ROAD SUSPENSION940 mm front assembly with 270 mm travel and 480 mm rear shock.
DUAL DISC BRAKESFront and rear disc brakes with 21/18-inch off-road tires.
